aiOs.truthBoundary: Hosted AI OS v0.1 boot proof only; do not claim native OS, production readiness, or general autonomous completion.

surfaces.label: app_cli_entrypoint
surfaces.goal: Wire the top-level AI OS CLI entrypoint to route boot/run/claim/ps/logs/approve commands through operator-userland modules with clear exit codes.

surfaces.label: operator_cli_boot
surfaces.goal: Implement hosted boot command orchestration, artifact-root initialization, and boot proof handoff.

surfaces.label: operator_cli_run
surfaces.goal: Implement job run command admission flow for examples/hello.job.json and AI OS process creation.

surfaces.label: operator_cli_claim
surfaces.goal: Implement claim command behavior that submits completion claims only through the verifier/claim gate.

surfaces.label: operator_cli_ps
surfaces.goal: Implement process table presentation for hosted AI OS jobs, threads, leases, and exit contracts.

surfaces.label: operator_cli_logs
surfaces.goal: Implement audit/log browsing for boot, run, claim, blocker, and recovery events.

surfaces.label: operator_approval_console
surfaces.goal: Implement approval console data contracts for external writes, destructive actions, and privileged kernel changes.

surfaces.label: operator_dashboard_model
surfaces.goal: Implement dashboard state model for kernel health, running jobs, proof status, blockers, and operator actions.

surfaces.label: kernel_process_admission
surfaces.goal: Implement process admission validation, owner binding, objective normalization, and initial lifecycle evidence references.

surfaces.label: kernel_state_transition
surfaces.goal: Implement allowed process state transitions, terminal states, failure reasons, and replayable transition records.

surfaces.label: kernel_exit_contract
surfaces.goal: Implement exit contract checks for done, blocked, killed, quarantined, and claim-submitted process exits.

surfaces.label: kernel_owner_identity
surfaces.goal: Implement owner identity normalization and authorization metadata for jobs and privileged actions.

surfaces.label: kernel_process_snapshot
surfaces.goal: Implement process snapshot serialization for ps, replay, recovery, and claim evidence.

surfaces.label: kernel_panic_stop
surfaces.goal: Implement panic/stop semantics for unsafe jobs, runaway workers, and external-write risk.

surfaces.label: scheduler_admission_queue
surfaces.goal: Implement job admission queue ordering, readiness, dependency hold, and operator override metadata.

surfaces.label: scheduler_budget_manager
surfaces.goal: Implement budget accounting for tokens, messages, wall-clock, retries, and 45-wide wave policy.

surfaces.label: scheduler_context_pack
surfaces.goal: Implement context-pack shaping for compact worker launches, memory mounts, and assigned-file retrieval.

surfaces.label: scheduler_dependency_graph
surfaces.goal: Implement dependency graph validation, ready frontier selection, and cycle/blocker reporting.

surfaces.label: scheduler_execution_plane_registry
surfaces.goal: Implement execution-plane registry selection for local control plane vs Hetzner worker plane.

surfaces.label: scheduler_lease_manager
surfaces.goal: Implement worker leases, lease renewal, stale lease detection, and recovery-safe ownership.

surfaces.label: scheduler_model_policy
surfaces.goal: Implement model/provider policy selection for planner, compact worker, verifier, and reviewer roles.

surfaces.label: scheduler_usage_backoff
surfaces.goal: Implement usage-limit/backoff tracking for OAuth/message-metered Codex lanes and resume timing.

surfaces.label: artifact_root
surfaces.goal: Implement stable artifact-root initialization, namespace layout, required boot paths, and root metadata.

surfaces.label: artifact_bundle_manifest
surfaces.goal: Implement content-addressed artifact bundle manifests for boot, run, claim, release, and recovery packets.

surfaces.label: artifact_content_address
surfaces.goal: Implement digest/address helpers for evidence artifacts, manifests, and tamper checks.

surfaces.label: artifact_path_policy
surfaces.goal: Implement safe path policy for artifact writes, quarantine, and repo-relative proof references.

surfaces.label: artifact_claim_evidence_link
surfaces.goal: Implement claim-to-evidence linking so every claim can trace required proof artifacts.

surfaces.label: artifact_replay_index
surfaces.goal: Implement replay index records that map jobs/processes/claims to audit and artifact bundles.

surfaces.label: memory_mount
surfaces.goal: Implement memory mount descriptors for project, structural, episodic, artifact, and volatile memory.

surfaces.label: memory_project_adapter
surfaces.goal: Implement project memory adapter contracts for reading/writing canonical project status safely.

surfaces.label: memory_structural_adapter
surfaces.goal: Implement structural memory adapter contracts for code graph lookups and source provenance.

surfaces.label: memory_episodic_log
surfaces.goal: Implement episodic log adapter for durable run events, handoffs, and operator-visible summaries.

surfaces.label: memory_freshness_gate
surfaces.goal: Implement freshness gates for volatile facts before current-state claims are allowed.

surfaces.label: capability_token
surfaces.goal: Implement capability token shape, scope, expiry, delegation, and audit references.

surfaces.label: capability_policy_evaluator
surfaces.goal: Implement capability policy evaluator for syscall, file, shell, deploy, and external-write decisions.

surfaces.label: capability_external_write_guard
surfaces.goal: Implement external-write guard requiring explicit approval and draft-vs-send boundaries.

surfaces.label: capability_destructive_action_guard
surfaces.goal: Implement destructive-action guard for delete, deploy, privileged mutation, and irreversible operations.

surfaces.label: capability_rate_limit
surfaces.goal: Implement capability-aware rate limiting for model calls, external systems, and operator interrupts.

surfaces.label: syscall_registry
surfaces.goal: Implement builtin syscall registry and metadata for fs, shell, git, memory, verifier, claim, and audit syscalls.

surfaces.label: syscall_fs_read
surfaces.goal: Implement fs.read syscall contract with scope checks, path policy, and audit output.

surfaces.label: syscall_fs_write
surfaces.goal: Implement fs.write syscall contract with capability checks, artifact/product distinction, and audit output.

surfaces.label: syscall_shell_exec
surfaces.goal: Implement shell.exec syscall contract with sandbox policy, timeout, evidence capture, and risk labels.

surfaces.label: claim_allowance
surfaces.goal: Implement claim allowance evaluation requiring verifier evidence, truth boundary, and contradiction checks.

surfaces.label: verifier_result
surfaces.goal: Implement verifier result normalization and green/red evidence for boot/run/claim gates.

surfaces.label: release_packet
surfaces.goal: Implement release packet assembly for hosted boot proof, claim gate, artifact bundle, and human review.

runtime.truthBoundary: Agent Work v0.1 defaults to the objective controller. The finite transfer runner remains available only as an explicit single-wave runner.
